summary.subject: GET /orders
summary.sentence: `GET /orders` ran `SELECT id, order_id, product_name, price FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?` 5 or more times after another statement in 3 of 3 requests, up to 30 times in one.
whatToCheck: Open an exemplar request in Live Activity and check whether each repeat loads the children of one row the first statement returned.
If it does, load them with one statement, such as a join or an IN list, in SQL Trace's call site.
limitations: Counts statements the request ran; a statement Hibernate batches counts once.
JDBC row counts, when known, do not establish how many entities or response items a query produced.
SQL text in findings is named as a statement shape because secret-looking names can mask the rest of a sentence.
Total repeat time is 90 ms, summed across affected requests.
Without the transaction source, which the runtime journal does not record, its evidence is not counted.
summary.unlistedReason: Its rows appear when all rows are shown, or when a search or a query names this check or its route.
